body.purpose: All primary UI text, values, and content. Monospace is the brand.

label.purpose: Section labels, badges, nav items. Uppercase, wide tracking.

section-title.purpose: Panel section headers. Most tracked of the label styles.

shadows.name: map-popup
shadows.purpose: Leaflet seizure popup only. The single shadow in the entire design.

components.name: Card
components.description: Panel and content container. Flat surface with subtle border.

components.name: Badge Live
components.description: LIVE / NEW pill. White on black — the only white-on-dark element in the palette.
components.css: .ds-badge-live { display: inline-block; background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Badge Severity
components.description: Severity encoding. Transparent bg, colored border + text. Three variants: critical/high/low.

components.name: Button Primary
components.description: Primary action button. Signal red bg, white text. Hover darkens.

components.name: Button Ghost
components.description: Ghost button. Transparent bg, gray border, gray text. Hover lightens.
components.css:
.ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #8E8E8E; border: 1px solid #333333; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; }
.ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #8E8E8E; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input. Black bg, medium border, mono font. Focus shifts border to accent red.

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation item. Transparent default, red left border on active.

narrative.overview: A terminal-native intelligence dashboard that frames real Indian drug seizure data as a live mission-control surface. The aesthetic draws from 2000s ops-center HUDs — not cyberpunk pastiche, not SaaS dashboard. The map is the mission; the panels are briefing documents; the typography is monospace and tabular. Everything is dark, dense, and deliberate. Pure black body with tonal layering for depth, signal red as the single accent used sparingly, and severity encoding that doubles as data visualization.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black body with tonal layering (no shadows on UI)
Signal red accent used sparingly (≤5% of any screen)
Share Tech Mono throughout — the brand font
Severity colors: red/orange/yellow for volume thresholds

rules.name: The Signal Red Rule
rules.body: The accent is used only on active states, critical badges, and the live pulse indicator. It never decorates a border or background. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Mono-Only Rule
rules.body: All UI text is Share Tech Mono. No switching to sans-serif for 'readability'. The monospace is the aesthetic commitment.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: All surfaces are flat at rest. Borders and tonal background shifts create depth. Shadows appear in exactly one place: the Leaflet map popup.

dos: Do use the signal red accent sparingly. Active nav, critical badges, and the live pulse only. Never on borders or decorative elements.
Do use severity colors consistently: red = critical (>200 count or >100kg), orange = high (>100 or >10kg), yellow = standard.
Do use Share Tech Mono for all UI text.
Do use tonal layering for depth instead of shadows.
Do use the dot-grid background pattern on the main app surface.
donts: Don't use shadows on panel surfaces. The Leaflet popup is the only exception.
Don't use the accent color on borders or decorative elements.
Don't use gradient backgrounds, glassmorphism, or neon glow effects.
Don't use sans-serif fonts as the primary UI font.
Don't use severity colors for decoration — they encode meaning.
